title: An Initial Study of Physiological Markers for Deepfake Speech Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.18934v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Conventional deepfake speech detectors primarily target synthesis artifacts and often degrade under unseen attacks or recording conditions. Human speech, however, contains physiological markers associated with respiration, phonation, and temporal coordination arising from the speech-production system that synthesizers may not reproduce faithfully. This motivates the hypothesis that deepfake speech can be detected by identifying inconsistencies in these patterns, which we test using 36 handcrafted physiological markers organized into respiratory, vocal, and temporal categories. We evaluate the marker vectors with logistic regression and SVM classifiers on pooled English recordings. The best in-domain system achieves a 21.40% equal error rate (EER), while logistic regression achieves 32.77% on the out-of-domain dataset pair. translated_title: 深度伪造语音检测的生理标记初步研究
translated_abstract: 传统的深度伪造语音检测器主要针对合成痕迹，在未见过的攻击或录音条件下性能往往下降。然而，人类语音中包含与呼吸、发声以及言语产生系统的时间协调相关的生理标记，而语音合成器可能无法忠实地再现这些标记。这引出了一个假设：可以通过识别这些模式中的不一致性来检测深度伪造语音。我们使用组织为呼吸、发声和时间三大类的36个手工设计的生理标记来验证这一假设。我们在合并的英语录音上使用逻辑回归和SVM分类器对标记向量进行评估。最佳的域内系统达到了21.40%的等错误率（EER），而逻辑回归在域外数据集对上达到了32.77%。由于这些标记描述了特定的言语产生特性，逻辑回归系数可以指示……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出利用36个基于人类言语产生系统（呼吸、发声、时间协调）的手工生理标记来检测深度伪造语音，验证了通过识别生理模式不一致性检测伪造语音的可行性，域内最佳等错误率达21.40%，并在跨域场景下展现出一定的泛化能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes detecting deepfake speech using 36 handcrafted physiological markers related to respiration, phonation, and temporal coordination of human speech production, achieving a 21.40% EER in-domain and demonstrating out-of-domain generalization.
